findings.title: A double tap on any B04 action replaces the toast with the no-op's message, and Undo then does nothing
findings.detail: patterns.md §7's tap guard (`lib/tap-guard.ts`) is imported only by B03's files (`rows.tsx`, `review.tsx`, `skipped.tsx`, `txn.tsx`). No B04 screen uses it. A second tap runs the command again; the fake answers `Already …` with `touched: []`, that message becomes the toast, and its Undo restores a state that is already the changed one. The first change stays, and the person has no way to undo it. The same happens on *Submitted* (claim), and by the same code path on *Lock without waiting*, *Everyone* and the Sen *Apply*-style buttons.
findings.repro: dev server or preview: More -> Shared bills -> HAIDILAO -> double-tap "I've paid", then tap Undo in the toast. Spec file: qa/e2e/b04-dbl.spec.ts (split) and b04-claims.spec.ts (claim).

findings.title: The shared command schemas (`packages/core/src/commands.ts`) accept hostile input, and `balance.check` can double-book
findings.detail: No B04 free-text field has a max length (100k-character email, Sen text, friend name, essRef all ACCEPTED); `balance.check` allows 10,000 rows and duplicate `accountId`s. With a duplicate, both adjustments are computed from the same snapshot, so after typing RM14,750.87 the balance is RM14,850.87. `member.set` `grant` takes any safe integer and the balance sums past it (`safe: false`). The UI can't produce these (parseSen caps at RM99,999,999,999.99, one box per account), but B05 turns these schemas into the API's contract.
findings.recheck: Schema probes: 255+ char email, 4001-char Sen text, 61-char friend name, balance.check with 0, 51 or duplicate rows, a grant of 9e15, a 65-char essRef, a 101-char key, a 2001-char setting string: all rejected; boundaries (254, 4000, 60) accepted. The fake refuses a duplicate balance check ("Each account once.", 0 adjustments, balance unchanged) and a second grant past the range (balance 9000000000340, safe). Leftovers in finding 20.
